sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive and traditional leadership dominates as Energy, Healthcare, and a surging Consumer Defensive sector post all-green profiles, while cyclical groups lose ground.

Energy maintains undisputed market leadership with a near-perfect momentum score of 0.967 and the top overall rank, flanked by sustained strength in Healthcare (0.783 momentum). Rotational flows are heavily favoring safety, evidenced by Consumer Defensive advancing 3 spots over the last five sessions to capture the number 3 rank alongside an identical 0.783 momentum reading.

Conversely, cyclical and rate-sensitive sectors are fading broadly. Industrials dropped 2 spots to rank 6 (0.300 momentum) and Basic Materials slipped 1 spot to rank 4 (0.450 momentum), while Consumer Cyclical sits at the bottom of the table at rank 11 with market-low momentum of 0.233. 

## Strength
- Energy is the clear market anchor, boasting the #1 rank, sustained top-3 performance across 1-, 3-, and 6-month timeframes, and a 0.967 momentum score.
- Defensive breadth is concentrated: only 3 of 11 sectors are all-green across all time horizons (week, month, quarter, half, YTD), comprising Energy (0.967), Consumer Defensive (0.783), and Healthcare (0.783).
- Healthcare shows sustained multi-month strength alongside Energy, holding the #5 rank with 0.783 momentum.

## Movers & Momentum
- Consumer Defensive is the sole major positive mover over the last 5 sessions, gaining 3 spots to hit rank 3 with 0.783 momentum.
- Industrials suffered the steepest short-term drop, losing 2 spots to rank 6 with momentum slipping to 0.300.
- Basic Materials also deteriorated, sliding 1 spot to rank 4 (0.450 momentum).
- Momentum laggards are anchored by Consumer Cyclical (0.233 momentum, rank 11), Utilities (0.267 momentum, rank 10), and Real Estate (0.283 momentum, rank 8).

## Divergences
- Technology retains the #2 rank but displays a divergent, mid-tier momentum score of 0.567, trailing the top three momentum leaders.
- A stark cyclical-versus-defensive divide is widening: Consumer Defensive gained 3 spots to reach rank 3, directly contrasting Consumer Cyclical, which remains stagnant at rank 11 with the lowest momentum in the market (0.233).
- Industrials holds a mid-tier rank (#6) despite weak momentum (0.300) and a 2-spot rank drop, tracking closer to laggards like Communication Services (0.367 momentum, rank 9).

- Healthcare - RS cross: Track whether the fresh positive relative strength cross against SPY gains traction; confirmed by relative strength holding above the trigger line on a closing basis, invalidated by an undercut of the crossover pivot.
- Basic Materials - RS new high: Look for momentum continuation as relative strength reaches a 20-session high; confirmed by price expansion supporting the new RS peak, invalidated if relative strength experiences an immediate mean reversion back inside its previous 20-session range.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy dominates market leadership with exceptional momentum, while cyclical tech, construction, and consumer groups suffer sharp weekly rank declines.

Market leadership remains heavily concentrated in traditional energy, with Oil & Gas Integrated (momentum 0.956), Refining & Marketing (0.948), and E&P (0.930) anchoring the 25 all-green groups and holding sustained top-tier performance across multi-month horizons. Concurrently, defensive and staple-adjacent industries are making aggressive short-term moves, evidenced by gains in Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries (+24 spots) and Medical Distribution (+17 spots, momentum 0.88).

Conversely, severe rotations are striking growth, infrastructure, and transport names over the past five sessions. Engineering & Construction plunged 26 spots (momentum 0.30), Software - Infrastructure dropped 25 spots to rank 58, and Airlines dropped 21 spots to rank 117 (momentum 0.23). Meanwhile, bottom-tier momentum laggards like Mortgage Finance (0.030) and Gambling (0.052) remain anchored at the lowest YTD ranks.

## Strength
- **Pervasive Energy Leadership:** Oil & Gas Integrated (0.956 momentum, rank 4 YTD), Refining & Marketing (0.948 momentum, rank 1 YTD), and E&P (0.930 momentum, rank 7 YTD) are all-green and sustained top-36 performers over 1-, 3-, and 6-month frames.
- **Healthcare & Defensive Breadth:** 25 of 144 groups hold all-green status, led by Medical Distribution (0.88 momentum), Diagnostics & Research (0.82 momentum), and Insurance - Reinsurance (0.84 momentum).
- **Consumer Stability:** Lodging (0.83 momentum) and Beverages - Brewers (0.82 momentum) sustain positive performance across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD windows.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Rapid Weekly Ascenders:** Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries gained 24 spots (to rank 57, momentum 0.79), Shell Companies surged 21 spots (to rank 29, momentum 0.78), and Medical Distribution jumped 17 spots (to rank 41).
- **Severe Short-Term Drawdowns:** Engineering & Construction shed 26 spots (rank 51, momentum 0.30), Software - Infrastructure dropped 25 spots (rank 58, momentum 0.59), and Internet Retail fell 23 spots (rank 88, momentum 0.42).
- **Persistent Momentum Laggards:** Mortgage Finance (0.030 momentum, rank 142 YTD), Gambling (0.052 momentum, rank 143 YTD), and Solar (0.059 momentum, rank 139 YTD) remain deeply entrenched at the bottom.

## Divergences
- **Fading High-Momentum Groups:** Health Information Services (0.73 momentum) and Real Estate - Diversified (0.65 momentum) both dropped 4 spots over the past 5 days, joined by Copper (0.70 momentum, rank -1) and Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances (0.61 momentum, rank -2).
- **Emerging Low-Momentum Rebounds:** Telecom Services jumped 11 spots despite low 0.34 momentum, while Restaurants (+8 spots, 0.40 momentum) and Packaged Foods (+7 spots, 0.41 momentum) exhibit early rank improvements.
